subject: Expansion request: additional teams + API key safelist and amendment
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenline.ai>, Procurement <procurement@greenline@greenline.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request to expand to 6 additional internal teams / API keys + amendment

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the great work getting our first two products onboarded — the latency improvements have been noticeable. Were now looking to expand Redwood across six more internal teams (search, recommendations, content-moderation, analytics, sales-assist, and docs-summarization). High-level asks: 

- Please provision 6 additional API key bundles (one per new project) and add our app IP ranges to a safelist so requests from our VPC-hosted services don't get throttled during initial rollout.
- Well need a modest increase in our monthly reserved commit to cover steady-state usage and a small burst margin during launch weeks. Can you provide an amendment with projected cost and lead-time?
- Procurement will require an editable amendment and a draft PO to attach to the companys finance system.

Proposed kickoff for provisioning & infra tests: June 15. Can Redwood support a 2-week staggered rollout (2 teams per week) and an on-call window for day-of incidents?

Attached: capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (contains rough token/RPS forecasts).

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Integrations
GreenLine AI

[Attachment: capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (Excel, ~140KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to expand to 6 additional internal teams / API keys + amendment

Elena —

Great to hear and congrats on the quick value capture. We can absolutely support a staggered rollout and an on-call window; Marissa (CS) and I will scope the mutual action plan. Next items from our side to keep things moving: 

1) Please share the list of app owners (name + email) for each of the six teams so we can generate per-project API key bundles and safelist entries.
2) Confirm the IP ranges or VPC egress subnets you want added to the safelist.
3) Any compliance docs or additional firewall constraints we should know about before we open access?

Ive attached our standard pre-onboard checklist to speed collection of those details. Once we have the app owner list and IP ranges, well provision temporary keys for smoke tests and draft the amendment for committed units.

Proposed next steps: Marissa will send a short capacity questionnaire; Rishi (sales) will draft the amendment language and an estimated price uplift. Can we target signature by June 11 to hit your June 15 kickoff?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pre-onboard-checklist.pdf (PDF, ~55KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenline.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to expand to 6 additional internal teams / API keys + amendment

Hi Elena —

Looping in a few quick scoping questions so we can size commit tiers and ensure the safelist/keys are configured correctly: 

- Expected steady-state tokens/day per team and estimated peak tokens/minute during launch (rough numbers are fine).
- Typical average response length in tokens for each app (search ~60 tokens, recommendations ~120 tokens, etc. — if these differ let us know).
- Do any of these teams require stricter data residency or retention settings?

Based on similar expansions, an initial reserved uplift of ~30% on top of current commit usually covers launch spikes plus steady growth; well present two pricing options: a conservative uplift (30%) and an aggressive forecast (55%) with different burst allowances. Ive attached a quick estimate workbook with both scenarios.

We can also safelist by project-level API keys and by IP range; if you prefer to limit to VPC egress only well need explicit subnet ranges.

If youd like, we can schedule a 30-minute scoping call tomorrow to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: estimate-breakdown.xlsx (Excel, ~90KB)]

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenline.ai>, Procurement <procurement@greenline@greenline.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to expand to 6 additional internal teams / API keys + amendment

Thanks Tessa/Marissa — answers below inline.

- Steady-state tokens/day per team (estimate): search 1.4M, recommendations 2.1M, content-moderation 0.9M, analytics 0.6M, sales-assist 0.7M, docs-summarization 0.8M.
- Peak tokens/min (during launch weeks): expect 3-4x steady for the first 10 business days.
- Average response length: search ~45 tokens, recommendations ~110, moderation ~30, analytics ~200, sales-assist ~85, docs ~320 tokens.
- Data residency: no additional restrictions; all teams use US regions.

Procurement is asking for a redlined amendment and an editable Word doc for the legal team. Theyve also asked us to include a draft PO number (we will provide PO after review). Attaching GreenLines procurement requirements.

Well share the app owners list and subnets by EOD tomorrow.

Elena

[Attachment: greenline_requirements.pdf (PDF, ~210KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft amendment & DocuSign for signature

Elena —

Thanks for the detail — Ive put together a short amendment that: (1) increases your monthly committed units by 35% (midpoint between conservative/aggressive scenarios), (2) adds a 30% burst pool for the first 30 days post-rollout, (3) calls out issuance of 6 project-specific API key bundles, and (4) includes safelist by provided IP ranges.

Link to draft amendment (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.net/sign/ABCDEFG123456789
Attached: amendment_draft.docx (editable).

If Procurement confirms the PO number we can set keys to active immediately after the executed amendment + receipt of PO. Proposed timeline: signature by June 9, provisioning smoke keys June 10, staged rollout starting June 15.

Let me know if Procurement needs any changes to payment terms or invoicing language.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: amendment_draft.docx (Word, ~45KB)]

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@greenline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenline@greenline.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenline.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft amendment & DocuSign for signature

Rishi/Tessa/Marissa —

Procurement reviewed the amendment and will sign via DocuSign this afternoon. Theyve provided a provisional PO: PO_GL_45921. Once the amendment is executed and you confirm the PO is on file, please move forward with issuing the six project keys and adding the safelist entries for the subnets well send tomorrow.

Also note: Finance prefers invoices be addressed to GreenLine AI, Attn: Accounts Payable (ap@greenline.ai) and references PO_GL_45921 on each invoice.

Thank you all for turning this around so quickly — were excited to ramp these teams.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Integrations
GreenLine AI

[Attachment: PO_GL_45921.pdf (PDF, ~28KB)]
